newsitem.title: USA: China to be touched on at Denver summit-Summers.
newsitem.headline: China to be touched on at Denver summit-Summers.

text.p: Developments in China were something that would be touched on at the Group of Seven summit in Denver next week, Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said Thursday.

"I'm sure that given its importance to the global system both politically, economically and financially, I'm sure as the leaders meet and as the finance minsisters meet, aspects of developments in China certainly will be something that is touched on in the discussions in Denver," Summers said.
Answering questions after a luncheon speech to an event organized by the Institute for International Economics, Summers said he was not aware of any plans to include China in the meetings.
Russia has been creeping closer to acceptance into the G7 group of wealthy nations but there is no G8 yet.
"I'm aware of no plans of any kind to discuss China's inclusion in these meetings or the G9," he said.
"I think obviously over the long term the general question of China's inclusion in the international system, that has many many parts, will be an important one."
